series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
A Zero Month crossover issue. Publishing magnate Randall Spire has a new goal: to bring down the legend of the Batman. Spire, nicknamed the “Legendkiller,” is out for any hard facts he can find on the dark knight. After gathering research from reporters failed, Spire now turns to storytellers, hoping their skills will piece together the puzzle of the Batman. Of course, the storytellers fail as well. Spire, angered, turns to find the Batman waiting for him. Spire had himself committed a bombing designed to prevent his company from being bought out. Spire has no need for reporters or storytellers; he knows the Batman personally now.

Notes:

  • This issue has thirteen one-to-two-page panels culled from numerous future Batman works.
  • The letter column contains a one paragraph memorial mentioning the recent death of Neal Pozner.
  • "DC Universe 20" one page Zero Hour advertisement featuring the front page of the Daily Planet with the headline "Zero Hour for Earth?"

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: In an era with thought police, telepathic crime lords, and antigravity technology, can the legend of the Dark Knight survive? A hundred years in the future, Gotham City is a very different place, but it is still a very dark place--and a place in need of a protector.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Spook" part 1! A blizzard is approaching as a handful of the most wealthy and influential individuals on Earth gather at an isolated mountain lodge to meet with Bruce Wayne. But when the lights go out and the servants all disappear, people begin to die, one by one.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Spook, a former special operative for the U.S. government and now apparently a real spook, dies at the hands of someone else at the mansion. Consumed by vengeance, the Spook plans on killing everyone else in the mansion, one by one, to find his murderer. "Spook" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Hunting the one who "killed" him, the Spook knows that someone in the house is the one responsible for his death. And as Batman prepares to rip open the supernatural-seeming villain's shroud of secrets, he finds one person within the group is helping the Spook. "Spook" part 3.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Joker is up to it again and with Batman out of the picture that means that makes Gotham a whole lot more harder. And it's up to James Gordon the commissioner of the Gotham police department to stop the joker but can Gordon stop the Joker.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: With Batman still unheard from, the Joker's rampage moves toward a climax that can destroy Gotham City. As the homicidal clown and his allies prepare to strike with an oil-tanker-turned-super-weapon, only Jim Gordon and his thin blue line of Gotham cops stand in the way. "Duty" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Stalking" part 1! The "Summer of Peace" in Gotham City is shattered when a killer targets the city! Terror grows as the killer displays no rhyme or reason in attack: everyone is a target. Can Batman stop the enigmatic murderer before another seemingly random victim falls?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The mysterious cyclist who seems to be randomly killing passers-by proves to be not-so-random after all. She has Captain Gordon in her sights, but not to kill. The Dark Knight must find what links Gordon's past to the killer before she makes the streets of Gotham run red with the blood of her cause. "Stalking" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Primal Riddle Part 1 of 3: Chapter One: Nasty, Brutish, and Short!
description:
Batman is critically injured in a battle with the Riddler. The near-death experience separates his spirit from his physical being and the Dark Knight remains silent and devoid of emotion, despite Alfred's care!

The issue begins with Batman facing off with Riddler at the top of Gotham's clock tower. Riddler kicks Batman off the tower and into a power line where he is electrocuted. Batman has an out-of-body experience in which he sees his mother and father, Martha and Thomas Wayne. They let him know they are proud of him, and he has "fulfilled" his vow to them. Bruce's parents let him know they were able to see him from the other side and it is time for them to be reunited. Unbeknownst to Bruce, a paramedic gives him an adrenaline shot which whisks him away from his parents although his is still out of body. A bystander exclaims to a child dressed as batman that the shows over and Batman got what all heroes get eventually. Batman comes to in a hospital, the doctor lets him know the electric shock from the power line through him of the line itself before he could be burnt badly. When the doctor turns his back Batman disappears. Alfred picks up Batman and notices that he doesn't seem his normal self and is not talking at all. The scene shifts to Tommy, the kid who witnessed the fight between Riddler and Batman. It is the next morning; Tommy's mom is scolding him for waking her and her boyfriend up pretending to be Batman. The boyfriend comes at Tommy, and Tommy takes him down and runs off. In the Batcave, Alfred takes a call from Gotham Police Headquarters for Batman and states the Riddler has another riddle. Batman, still not talking, shows up at the place Riddler's Riddle designated, a restaurant named Windows of Gotham. Batman quickly takes down Riddler's goons while the Riddler himself escapes. While he flees the Riddler comments that something appeared to be off with Batman. We cut back to Tommy with what appears to be himself on a rooftop. He slips and falls off, catching himself on a flagpole on the side of the building he hangs and pops his shoulder out of place. Shortly after a fire truck comes and rescues Tommy from hanging on the side of the building. Batman thinks to himself "missing something...can't think what".

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Primal Riddle Part 2 of 3: Chapter Two: Perhaps the Only Riddle That We Shrink From Giving Up!
description: Batman's body is missing its soul, and wants to get it back--fast. There's only one problem: Batman's soul is inhabiting the body of one of his deadliest enemies, the Riddler! "Primal Riddle" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman must escape Riddler's foolproof deathtrap in time to recover his own lost soul. But time is of the essence, as Batman's empty shell of a body has begun adjusting to the status quo and soon will be closed to his soul's return. "Primal Riddle" part 3.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Lord Demise, the ruthless leader of a terrorist group, takes over the luxury cruise ship known as the Adriatic King. On board for a Halloween-themed excursion is the ship's new owner: Bruce Wayne.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: It's a battle of titans as Batman tries to wrest control of the cruise ship Adriatic King from Lord Demise. The stakes are especially high for the Dark Knight since, if he goes down with the ship, a thousand passengers go with him.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: When an error in judgment finds an inexperienced Dark Knight wounded and fighting for life in the unfamiliar streets of Chicago, his only hope of survival may be the strange denizens of the city's darkest slums.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Many years ago, a tragic accident on the Gotham River resulted in the birth of an aquatic creature dwelling in the caves that connect to those beneath Wayne Manor. Now the creature's obsession with a locket that belonged to Martha Wayne leads to a confrontation with the Batman!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: No Man's Land: Fear of Faith, Part One: Fanning the Flames
description:
Fear of Faith: 1

Remembrance of Bob Kane in this issue.

Continued in Shadow of the Bat #84

"No Man's Land" part 5. A new chapter of the No Man's Land saga begins with Fear of Faith! Chaos continues to reign in Gotham City as citizens stand huddled in fear--and when fear comes into play, the Scarecrow isn't far behind!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "No Man's Land" part 9, "Bread and Circuses" part 1. Batman takes the battle for Gotham City to the Penguin's Iceberg Lounge, a refuge for anyone with something to barter--even if it's that person's own life! Continued in BATMAN: SHADOW OF THE BAT #85.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "No Man's Land" part 13. Learn how Alfred Pennyworth has spent his time since Gotham's fall as he shares a campfire story--one that bears a striking resemblance to his relationship with the Dark Knight--with a group of orphans.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "No Man's Land" part 17, "Claim Jumping" part 1. Batman vs. Two-Face! Commissioner Gordon and his "Blue Boys" vs. the Penguin! And who is the mysterious Russian woman named Echo? Two-Face is springing her from Blackgate, but her past and powers remain shrouded in mystery. Continued in BATMAN: SHADOW OF THE BAT #87.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman gathers his forces in "Assembly," a self-contained story that represents a critical turning point in the battle to reclaim "No Man's Land," beginning with the revelation of Batgirl's true identity! The Dark Knight has alienated those who once trusted him with their lives ? Robin, Nightwing and Oracle among them. After unmasking the new Batgirl and replacing her with another mysterious heroine and summoning Azrael to his side, Batman must now regain his former allies' trust and co-ordinate their efforts if his plan to regain control of Gotham is to succeed.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman battles Mr. Freeze for a vital source of power in "No Man's Land!" Freeze is attempting to expand his range of operations from the Gotham power plant he controls through Chinatown and beyond to push the city further into anarchy. But the Dark Knight has other plans, resulting in an action-packed, explosive confrontation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: No Man's Land: Low Road to Golden Mountain, Part 1: ...Where the Lights are Burning Low
description: Batman discovers Lynx beaten and left for dead in Chinatown where they discover the secret behind Chinatown's electricity supply - slave immigrants. After exploring her own origins in slavery (including King Snake) Lynx and Batman put aside their differences to stop the slavers - when they are ambushed.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Underground Railroad Part 1

Detective Bock and Dr. DeVries are on the search for necessary medical supplies for sick children. Of course they must head to the supply kingpin The Penguin in order to get it. Dr. DeVries agrees to care for the Penguin's sick birds in return for the medicine. After the medicine runs dry Detective Bock agrees to fight a local gang leader called Angel for more supplies.

Continued in Shadow of the Bat #91

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: No Man's Land: Captain of Industry
description:
Captain of Industry

A local gang leader, Shanks, has found an underground access tunnel out of Gotham and is allowing people access for the right price. However, the tunnel is infested with savage cannibals (former Gothamites) living in the sewers. Batman goes undercover as Matches Malone to stop Shanks.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Commissioner Gordon and Batman have a heated discussion about the past few years events including Knightfall and Batman's "disappearance" after the earthquake. Batman goes as far as to remove his mask but Gordon refuses to look. They agree to work together once more and save Gotham.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
"No Man's Land" part 44, "Endgame" part 1. Everything is building to a boiling point! While Batman, Nightwing, Robin, Batgirl, Azrael, and Oracle search desperately for the Joker and Harley Quinn, the Huntress prepares to stop Pettit from going out of control! Continued in BATMAN #574.

Joker seems to have disappeared and the only who's worried about this is Batman. Meanwhile, the citizens of Gotham all enjoy the holiday season.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Arrow and the Bat: Part One of Five - The Meeting
description: Part 1 of a 5-part story revealing how Batman and Green Arrow Oliver Queen first met! "No Man's Land" is no more. A new Gotham City stands in its place, marking a turning point in the adventures of the Dark Knight and his closest allies. Reflecting the change, BATMAN: LEGENDS OF THE DARK KNIGHT returns to its roots, telling Batman stories free of present-day continuity from throughout the Dark Knight's career.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Arrow and the Bat: Part Two of Five - Safed
description: Part 2 of a 5-part story revealing how Batman and Green Arrow Oliver Queen first met! The Dark Knight and the Emerald Archer discuss their plan of action as all the action they could ever care to encounter breaks out around them! Meanwhile, half a world away, reporter Vicki Vale is on assignment learning the ways of the East, as the sinister Minister Skave and his incompetent General Zho are having what you might call a falling out.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Arrow and the Bat: Part Three of Five - The Failure
description: Part 3 of a 5-part story revealing how Batman and Green Arrow Oliver Queen first met! Minister Skave has enlisted the help of a super-soldier named Haim and orders him to roll out his secret weapon. Can Green Arrow withstand this latest plan to put him six feet under? Meanwhile, from the comfort of the Batcave, Bruce Wayne and Alfred plan the Dark Knight's next move to keep Oliver Queen alive.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Arrow and the Bat: Part Four of Five - Pursued
description: Part 4 of a 5-part story revealing how Batman and Green Arrow Oliver Queen first met! Everywhere Oliver Queen goes he senses he's not alone. Is this some sad, paranoid fantasy? Or is Percibah Skave's so-called ultimate archer on the verge of making his move to rid the world of Green Arrow? Meanwhile, playboy Bruce Wayne bides his time in fancy Gotham City restaurants. What gives?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Arrow and the Bat: Part Five of Five - Epiphany
description: Concluding a 5-part story revealing how Batman and Green Arrow Oliver Queen first met! Seemingly beaten by the henchman of the evil Minister Skave, Oliver Queen walks right into the lion's mouth and challenges his better, the super-marksman known as Sag, to a heads-on duel. The result: GA and Prince Yully, the "chosen one," find themselves sharing a jail cell and awaiting their doom. Now Queen wonders, "Where's Batman?" The answer will shock both him and you!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Bruce Wayne's girlfriend, Silver St. Cloud. Set soon after Rogers's aforementioned run, Part 1 of "Siege" finds a former military man named Brass making a mysterious arrival in Gotham City. Once one of America's finest soldiers, Brass now commands a deadly group of out-of-work mercenaries determined to loot Gotham and secure their own financial futures. But Brass has another motive: to expand his family's past connections to the Wayne family (connections that span several generations) to the present and future of Bruce Wayne's vast fortune. And to accomplish his goal, he has decided to enlist the services of one of Bruce Wayne's closest friends ? the aforementioned Silver St. Cloud ? by whatever means necessary. One of very few "civilians" to have learned the Dark Knight's true identity, will Silver be able to protect the greatest secret of the man she loves?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Family secrets rise to haunt the Dark Knight in Part 2 of the 5-part "Siege." As Colonel Brass plans his mercenary convention, Silver St. Cloud's inquiries into his true motives grow to the point where even Batman cannot save her from the madman's plans. And what is the connection between Brass and the Wayne Family legacy ? specifically, Bruce Wayne's grandfather, prohibition-era King of the Bootleggers Jack Wayne?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Family secrets rise to haunt the Dark Knight in Part 3 of the 5-part "Siege." The mercenary named Brass puts his plan to ransack Gotham into action -- and reveals a deeper, darker true motive for the attack: the pillaging and destruction of Wayne Manor. It's all a part of Brass' ultimate plan for revenge against the memory of Jack Wayne, grandfather of Bruce and the man behind the Wayne family fortune.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 4 of the 5-part "Siege." Batman attempts to wage a one-man war on Colonel Brass' Gotham raiders, but discovers Brass' onslaught's been nothing more than a diversion. What is the Colonel's goal? And why does it take him into the heart of Wayne Manor?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: This issue marks the ending of Archie Goodwin's final comic story before his death. He died before the story was fully written, and James Robinson is credited with writing the story's dialogue.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Terror: Part One of Five - The Blood-Bat
description: Hugo Strange returns to Gotham city, where he assumes a new identity and gets hired on as Arkham Asylum's newest psychiatrist.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Terror: Part Two of Five - Strange Scarecrow
description: Part 2 of "Terror." While Batman prowls the streets of Gotham in search of the mysterious female cat burglar, Dr. Hugo Strange has infiltrated the halls of Arkham Asylum and is brainwashing Jonathan Crane into re-embracing the alter ego that once fought Batman to a frightful near-standstill ? the Scarecrow! But once Strange has succeeded in his task, will the Scarecrow prove to be too dangerous for even him to handle?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Terror: Part Three of Five - Greatest Fear
description:
Overview

Part 3 of the 5-part "Terror." Hugo Strange has brought the Scarecrow out from the depths of quiet insanity and up to full, murderous speed -- only to become the new and improved Master of Fear's first victim. Now, without a master to hold his psychotic fury in check, the Scarecrow begins hunting down Gotham's finest heroes and villains -- starting with the Catwoman, whom he intends to use to lure Batman into a final, fatal deathtrap.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Terror: Part Four of Five - Horror House
description:
Overview

With Hugo Strange dead (again!), the Scarecrow initiates phase two of his plan to destroy Batman: the conversion of an abandoned mansion into a "Horror House" designed to kill anyone who steps over its deadly threshold. It's a series of deathtraps the likes of which Batman has never before faced.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Terror: Part Five of Five - Dead Man
description: The conclusion of the 5-part "Terror." The Scarecrow unleashes the ultimate deathtrap for Batman, in the Horror House redesigned with only one purpose ? to destroy the Dark Knight! But the Scarecrow hasn't counted on Hugo Strange who rises from the dead yet again to kill both Batman and Scarecrow.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Demon Laughs, Part One: Exit Screaming
description: Part 1 of the 4-part "The Demon Laughs." Batman's arch-nemesis, Ra's al Ghul, has come to the conclusion that he's missing the one ingredient necessary to fulfill his ambition of worldwide domination. And the man who holds that missing ingredient is none other than the Joker! For the first time, the Demon teams up with the Clown Prince of Crime to destroy the Dark Knight, and take over the world!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Demon Laughs, Part Two: Running Wild
description: Part 2 of the 4-part "The Demon Laughs." Ra's al Ghul wants a perfect world -- a world devoid of any and all human beings. The Joker, on the other hand, wants to see a world devoid of just a single person -- Batman -- and the Joker's agreed to help Ra's with his plan if Ra's returns the favor.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Demon Laughs, Part Three: The March Hare
description:
Part 3 of the 4-part "The Demon Laughs."  It was the team-up that never should have happened.  But now it has, and it's working wonderfully!  
Thanks to Ra's al Ghul, the Joker is about to put his master plan into action — the release of a Joker-gas bomb that will decimate the entire planet!  Of course, Batman will eventually stop the two — but that's only if Joker and Ra's don't kill each other first!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Demon Laughs, Part Four: Mad About You
description: The conclusion to the 4-part "The Demon Laughs." The Joker is dead ? and we're not joking! But there's one chance to revive him: a bath in the Lazarus Pit! Will Batman dump his greatest nemesis into the pit and give new life to the Clown Prince of Crime?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 1 of the 3-part "Bad," featuring artwork by Barry Kitson (Empire). Jordy is big and simple. A true innocent, he loves dogs and children ? and never would even think of using his enormous strength to hurt even a fly. But deep inside Jordy, something lurks...something bad. Can Batman remove the Bad without destroying Jordy?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman, already beaten nearly to death by the monstrous man-child Jordy, is aided by Dr. Temple in an attempt to discover the secret of Jordy's "Bad" alter-ego. But can the Dark Knight discover the cause and do something about it before Jordy begins another rampage of destruction?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The conclusion to the 3-part "Bad," featuring artwork by Barry Kitson (EMPIRE). Batman discovers the true nature of Jordy's "Bad" ? the demonic personality lurking within the soul of the gentle, simple-minded giant. But how can Batman exorcise a demon ? when the demon itself is capable of acting gentle!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Grimm, Part 1 of 5: I Encounter a Strange Girl
description: " A new Legend begins - this one focusing on Dick Grayson, at the very beginning of his career as Robin. The Boy Wonder follows a street pickpocket right into the lair of the joyfully inane Mother Grimm, who collects homeless and wayward children while putting them to work and allowing them to live in her subterranean world. But there's trouble in this 'paradise'"--DC solicitation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: This is part 2 of the Grimm storyline - Will Robin come back to Batman now that he's with Mother Grimm?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Grimm Part 3 of 5: A Terrible Tragedy
description: "Grimm," Part 3 of 5. Batman is trapped in a nightmare, while Robin revels in a dreamland. Will Robin be strong enough to recognize the truth about his newfound paradise, before it's too late for everyone?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: " If you thought Mother Grimm was bad for Batman's and Robin's health, wait until you meet Cyanide! She's the flip side of Mother Grimm's 'goodness,' and she's out for blood!"--DC solicitation

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Grimm Part 5 of 5: I Prove My Worth
description: " The story of Mother Grimm concludes, as Batman confronts the villainous Cyanide. Meanwhile, Robin stands alone against Mother Grimm's hoard of loyal followers"--DC solicitation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Beginning the new 2-part story "Colossus," by The Badger's Mike Baron and Bill Reinhold. A killer stalks the gleaming spires of Gotham. A killer dedicated to destroying the lives and legacy of the men who built the city itself! A killer that Batman is determined to stop before he kills again!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Someone is killing everyone connected to the long-dead designer of the Gotham Civic Center. But Batman is about to discover that's just the start of the killer's murderous plans!"--DC solicitation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Blink," Part 1 of 3. When a blind man with the power to see through the eyes of other men accidentally taps into the mind of a serial killer, Batman finds himself at the center of a conspiracy that reaches from the streets of Gotham straight up into its cathedrals of power.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Blink," Part 2 of 3. The road to oblivion narrows even further for Blink, the blind man who can "see" through the eyes of those he touches. As Blink makes contact with Batman and uses his "eyes" to discover Batman's deepest secrets, he is unaware that the "lone serial killer" he'd helped capture was in fact part of a conspiracy ? a conspiracy that will stop at nothing to see Blink dead.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Blink, the blind man who can see through the eyes of others, is forced to witness an execution through the victim's own eyes! And now Batman must track down the murderer without the assistance of the crime's only eyewitness!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A madman takes over a Gotham church, and only batman can bring him out before the house of God is reduced to a pile of smoldering rubble. But the madman's capture begins a journey of discovery for Captain Jim Gordon, one which takes him back to the streets of Chicago, for a confrontation with a scandalous past he thought he'd left behind forever (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: James Gordon has been kidnapped and brought ba to his hometown of Chicago to be tortured into revealing the name of the last surviving eyewitness to a grisly murder. The witness: his niece, Barbara! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
"Loyalties," Part 3 of 3. In the streets of Chicago, Batman is a fish out of water; in a town more corrupt than even Gotham, he must race against the clock to prevent the murder of his friend Jim Gordon…and Gordon's niece Barbara.

Also includes a 6 page preview of Gotham Central #1 (with Batman and Mr. Freeze / written by Ed Brubaker and Greg Rucka)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Joker is planning to make a movie starring himself but instead of himself playing as himself he uses an old actor from long time ago and paints him to look like The Joker himself. And the Joker has got some tricks up his sleeve on this movie so can Batman stop it before terror reaches the streets of Gotham find out in this smilin comic book.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
It's time for washed up movie comic Buddy Kantor's close-up…and the Joker's going to make sure he gets it, even if he has to kill Batman in the process! (DC solicitation)

Various Arkham Asylum inmates make a cameo appearance

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Blink, the Blind man who can see through the eyes of whomever he touches, is back! Batman decides he needs the unique services of his old "friend," but learns he's been kidnapped by a group that may be working for the government. Whatever their allegiances, it's clear that Blink is being held against his will - and only Batman can break him free! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: After searching high and low for the blind man who can see through the eyes of others, Batman finds Blink. Now the Dark Knight must fight for Blink's freedom by taking out the military units using Blink's powers to spy on international terrorists!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Overview"Don't Blink" Part 3 of 4. The baby merchant Blink's been inhabiting has been murdered by a guilt-ridden psychopath. Now Blink can do nothing more than watch through the eyes of a child as the maniac threatens to go ballistic!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Overview"Don't Blink," Part 4 of 4! The government agency that once employed Blink desperately wants him back - the ability to see through other people's eyes is too great an asset to pass up. Now the agency is going to extremes by kidnapping and threatening the life of Blink's girlfriend…leaving Batman determined to set her free!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
A stand-alone tale written by red-hot FABLES scribe Bill Willingham with art by Tom Fowler (Star Wars: Jango Fett, Grendel: Black, White and Red)! We've all imagined what it would be like to be Batman. Now imagine what it would be like if you were alone, injured, weaponless, and, worst of all, you had no memory of who or what you were. Where would you go? Who could you trust? Find out in "Urban Legend!"   
 
Reprinted in: 
  • Batman Begins : The Movie & Other Tales of the Dark Knight (2005)
  • Batman: Under The Cowl (2010)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Frank Sharp wasn't blessed with good looks…in fact, he's probably one of the ugliest men alive. Fortunately, nature balanced that by giving him the unique ability to make people do whatever he wants, just by shaking their hands. Frank uses his gift to work his way through Gotham's worlds of politics and crime…but how long will it be before Batman comes calling?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman's hot on the trail of Frank Sharp, who desperately tries to use his mind-altering powers to manipulate the criminal underworld! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: After Bruce Wayne's manipulated suicide attempt, Batman finally uncovers the secret of Frank Sharp's power. But can Batman break through Sharp’s mind-controlled police escort before Sharp flees Gotham for good? (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Testament Part 1 of 5: City of Fools
description: A new breed of vigilantes called Rough Justice burst onto the scene in Gotham. Inspired by Batman, they plan to wipe crime off the streets for good. But will their extreme methods accomplish what Batman's couldn't - or will they become the worst threat of all?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Testament Part 2 of 5: Betrayal of Brothers
description:
1. Testament Part 2 of 5 : Betrayal of Brothers (written by John Wagner)

"Frustrated by the extreme methods of the group, Hellfire tries to leave. But the only way out is in a body bag. Plus, Detective Ehrlich is convinced that Batman is connected to Rough Justice and leads the Gotham City Police Department on a manhunt for the Dark Knight!"--DC Solicitation.

2. Superman : Secret Identity (a 4 page promo / written by Kurt Busiek)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: '"Batman barely escapes the Gotham Police Department's trap, and Bruce Wayne becomes the focus of Rough Justice’s attention when they're forced to seek 'contributions' from Gotham's elite to fund their expensive war on crime!"--DC solicitation

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Overview

Rough Justice goes for the money in Part 4 of the 5-part "Testament." Desperate for cash, they've targeted Bruce Wayne, the wealthiest man in Gotham. Only they stumble across something even more damaging than the loss of Wayne's priceless artifacts: the journal of Batman!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "It's Batman’s final confrontation with Rough Justice — but how can the Dark Knight defeat an enemy who knows his secrets?"--DC solicitation

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Overview

Part 1 of the 2-part "Lost Cargo," a tale set in modern continuity told by Devin Grayson (NIGHTWING) with art by Jean-Jacques Dzialowski (BATGIRL) and Dan Green (Uncanny X-Men). With this story, LEGENDS returns to present continuity with stories that will impact Batman now and in the future! Catwoman is trying to crush a human slave trade run by the Lucky Hand Triad in Gotham City, but her timing couldn't be worse. While she's trying to wash the Lucky Hand off of the streets, another gang is looking to step into their place. The fireworks draw the attention of Batman and…Matches Malone?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 2 of the 2-part "Lost Cargo," a tale set in current continuity told by Devin Grayson (NIGHTWING) with art by Jean-Jacques Dzialowski (BATGIRL) and George Rodriguez. The clock is ticking on the lives of 30 exotic dancers, and Batman is nowhere to be found. But Catwoman and Matches Malone are on the case! Waitaminute...Catwoman is working with Matches!?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The mind-bending origin of Fat Man and Little Boy, from BATMAN's "Broken City," in a stand-alone issue written by A.J. Lieberman (BATMAN: GOTHAM KNIGHTS) with art by Greg Scott (GOTHAM CENTRAL, Sabretooth)! From their debut in Japan to the real reasons behind why they're in Gotham City, learn the secrets behind Batman's newest foes!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman and Oracle are trying to solve a string of murders that leads to a part of Gotham City no one knew existed! And while Batman dodges bullets and cracks skulls on the streets, Oracle's hunt brings her into a virtual world filled with her biggest dreams and her worst nightmares…a utopia that’s being tainted by the real world.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Overview
An investigation into the death of a computer hacker has led Oracle to a secret cyber-world hidden in the bowels of Gotham. But now more bodies are turning up, and someone who might just be the Joker has turned his attention to Oracle!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A massive power vacuum at the top of Gotham's top gangs has lead to Batman's nightmare scenario... all of the city's organized crime are striking out at once. The police aren't the only ones completely unequipped to handle this kind of situation, as Batman finds that he, Catwoman and Batgirl are woefully inadequate to quiet the menace. Reaching out to Orpheus, who he has placed in charge of the Hill mob, he begins working to consolidate the gangs under Orpheus' control.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman's efforts to contain the violent gang warfare that has erupted throughout Gotham aren't enough. Even though Tim Drake has once more taken up the Robin costume to help, Batman is unable to fight an entire city full of crime... and now he's strained his relationship with the relatively new Police Commissioner Akins. Deciding that he can do more good in another guise, he once more dons the identity of 'Matches' Malone, trying to gather information from the underworld, as well as make contact with whoever has orchestrated this chaos. Little does he know, that this devestation was accidentally started by Stephanie Brown, after he dismissed her as Robin. Attempting to prove herself to him, she tried to implement a plan she'd previously found in the computers of the batcave. But in not knowing all of Batman's secrets, she failed. Catwoman is the only one who knows, and she's sworn not to tell Bruce. But telling Leslie... that's different.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: War Games: The Road to Hell
description: Overview As Batman drowns in a sea of enemies, the rest of Gotham’s heroes race to save him! All the chaos and violence so far was merely a prelude to this. To make matters worse, the G.C.P.D. is about to break ranks!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 1 of the 5-part "Riddle Me That", the ultimate Riddler story! Someone is using riddles in the kidnapping of an influential Gotham City doctor. But the crime is more brutal than anything the Dark Knight has experienced with Edward Nigma. Who's the madman behind it all?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: There's an all-new Riddler wreaking havoc on the streets of Gotham--and he's three steps ahead of the Bat. Can Batman save a nosy graduate student from an horrific death and stop a bombing on a local commuter train?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 3 of the 5-part "Riddle Me That!" The transformation of Edward Nigma from second-rate has-been to villainous mastermind is revealed! And all the while, Batman careens from a fiery wreck atop a towering bridge!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Riddler's plan continues as he managed to fool Batman.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman thought to have beaten the Riddler at his game but founds himself outsmarted by him.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Mr. Freeze began robbing some seemingly random items. Batman get into investigation without finding the link for these items. When he finally confronts him, Freeze reveals his newest and strange plan.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
" Mr. Freeze bids farewell to Gotham City via a permanent deep freeze! Both Batman and Bruce Wayne must determine Freeze's motives in order to stop him from icing all of downtown Gotham!"--DC Solicitation. 
 
Cold Snap Part 2.
 
Batman discovers Freeze's real motives about stealing those seemingly random items, he was punishing himself for almost forgetting Nora, and now was trying to surround himself with all things that reminded him of her and hopefully dying with her memory, Batman tried to save him but the place exploded, Batman got out and was pretty sure that Freeze had gotten out too.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
" J. H. Williams III, Dan Curtis Johnson (CHASE) and Seth Fisher (GREEN LANTERN: WILLWORLD) deliver the 5-part "Snow," telling the origin of Mr. Freeze from a new perspective! A family tragedy, coupled with the creation of an untested technological development, forges the obsession of a super-villain."--DC Solicitation.

This story has Two Face as Harvey Dent.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
This issue is split between two loosely connected stories.

After feeling betrayed by his usual friends and resources from the previous issue, Batman tracks down several new "partners in crime" to assist him including a dishonorably discharged marine, a FBI forensic analyst, an electronics specialist, a criminal psychologist and an ex-con. In the BatComplex, Batman gives his new recruits their job details in a video conference. He asks them to return each night at the same time as part of the team. Each night, they return with increasing eagerness to be part of an effective secret agency. Time progresses and the team sets their sights on Peter Scotta, eventually uncovering some kind of deal going on that will boost him into the big leagues of crime. They intercept the place and time of the deal and Batman takes the investigation from there.

The rest of the issue deals with Victor and Nora. Victor Fries takes his wife out of the hospital and brings her to the cryogenics laboratory. He decides to put her into the machine so that he can preserve her life, which she apparently agrees to. However, someone has changed to programming of the machine, instead testing for military weaponry. He breaks open the machine in hopes of saving her but she is frozen into a block of ice. Distraught, Victor destroys his work and attempts to commit suicide from the cryogenic fluids. However, hallucinating, Victor sees Nora dressed as some kind of snow queen. She tells him to not let "them" win and he puts on the cryosuit.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman's surveillance team discovers the secret a corporation has kept that has transformed an ordinary research scientist into a mad menace to himself and all of Gotham!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Batman's operatives encounter Mr. Freeze and come to grips with the madman's plan to bring his wife back against all odds"--DC solicitation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: ' "The conclusion of the 5-part 'Snow,' featuring Batman's first confrontation with Victor Fries - a.k.a. Mr. Freeze! And what 'conclusion' will Batman draw from his experiences with a strike force?"--DC solicitation

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Blaze of Glory Part 1 of 3: The Spark
description: "A criminal with something to prove stalks Batman. But despite the crook's lack of resources, he proves to be not merely elusive, but deadly to the Dark Knight — and all of Gotham!"

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Blaze of Glory Part 2 of 3: The Fuse
description: Part 2 of the 3-part "Blaze of Glory" by Will Pfeifer (CATWOMAN) and Chris Weston (THE FILTH)! A thief who's been put away by Batman relives the humiliating moment of his capture and plots revenge by planning an atrocity no one in Gotham will ever forget!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Blaze of Glory Part 3 of 3: The Fire
description: "A dying career criminal waging a one-man war against Gotham City and Batman gets his final opportunity to go out in a 'Blaze of Glory!'"--DC solicitation.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Emergency Room of Gotham General Hospital is overwhelming for a rookie doctor on the best of days...but the hospital scene becomes pure pandemonium when the Joker is admitted, by Batman! But the Joker knows a secret that threatens all of Gotham City...and Batman must keep him alive at all costs to determine just what it is!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
"Cold Case" Part 1 of 3

A journalist has researched the identity of the Gotham Ripper, a mad serial killer — and the evidence points to Thomas Wayne! Can Batman clear his father's name? Things get more confusing when the journalist turns up dead!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Cold Case part 2 of 3 (The Coldest Case of All!)
description: A journalist has researched the identity of the Gotham Ripper, a mad serial killer — and the evidence points to Thomas Wayne! Can Batman clear his father's name? Things get more confusing when the journalist turns up dead! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Can Batman clear his father's name? Thomas Wayne's reputation may be destroyed unless the Dark Knight can prove his father wasn't a serial killer - and find the real murderer! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Madmen of Gotham Part 1 of 3
description: What is the secret from Gotham City's past that's driving its population insane today? Can Batman stop the madness, or will he succumb as well? (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Madmen of Gotham Part 2 of 3
description:
The man who drove Gotham mad!

The creature who calls herself "Vanity" is merely the first line of defense created by the mastermind who threatens all Batman's city. Who is this hidden persuader, and why does he know everything about the Dark Knight? (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: The Madmen of Gotham Part 3 of 3
description: Guardian of Gotham! Batman plummets from a five-story building - and things quickly get worse from there! The smartest man in Gotham is also the craziest...and he's somehow connected to Batman's past!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A very old - and very rich - family is threatened by a kidnapping, and Batman's investigation is compromised by Bruce Wayne's involvement with the victim's sister!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman has let a case become too personal, and that could have devastating consequences for the woman whose life he's trying to save! (DC solicitation)

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Part 3 of the 5-part "Darker Than Death," written by Bruce Jones (MAN-BAT) with fully rendered color art by Ariel Olivetti (SPACE GHOST)! Is the hostage Batman risked everything to save already beyond his - or anyone's - help?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Bruce Wayne accedes to the kidnappers' demands, but it may still be too late to save their hostage from certain death! Has Batman finally failed?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Nothing will prepare you for the twist in this tale of intrigue and kidnapping that could compromise even the Batman!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Where can a young man take a hot date that isn't clichéd? How about a crime scene on the rooftops of Gotham, to witness a Batman sighting?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A man who collects everything has begun collecting superhero memorabilia, and he's after something that belongs to Batman! The Dark Knight must travel to Tokyo to track down "The Otaku!"

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
A crooked financier is supposed to testify against his equally crooked boss - but he's been intimidated out of making it to court by the one man he fears more than Batman... Deadshot! (DC solicitation)

Final issue.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
"Mercy" was a by-the-book Gotham City cop...until her partner was savagely murdered by the Cossack, a brutal champion of the illegal street-fighting circuit. She turned to Batman for help, and he trained her to fight. Now, out to avenge her late partner, she has to enter the 'Blood Pit' and Batman has to stop her.

Notes:

  • Series numbering continues from Legends of the Dark Knight #36.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: It's not a hoax, not a dream, not an imaginary story! Bat-Mite is back in what just had to be called "Legend of the Dark Mite."

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
The Batman has just stopped a rather amateurish break-in...

What seems like a moment later, Bruce Wayne is lying down in a hospital bed.

Keith Marsland - psychiatric consultant

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Bruce Wayne is... lying on a hospital bed, a sick man.

Bruce Wayne is... Batman.

Which will he choose?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman takes a wrong turn into an abandoned movie studio and falls prey to a creature of the night more fearsome than himself. It's up to Alfred, fearless vampire hunter, to save his master from the curse of the undead in "Sunset." This 1-issue special is from the creative team of Scarlett.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Hothouse, Part 1 of 2. When a well-respected university regent leaps to his death before Batman's eyes, it raises a number of questions - questions to which Poison Ivy might hold the answers. But the only answer she'll give is that she's gone straight...and it seems she's telling the truth!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman does battle with Poison Ivy as she tries to control him and everyone else in her path.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Turf, Part 1 of 2. It's the early years of Batman's and Gordon's careers, and teen gang violence rips through Gotham City, spearheaded by the Brotherhood of the White Night, a white-supremacist gang. In the course of investigating gang and racial violence, Batman uncovers a gang of police officers with a murderous agenda of its own!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Turf, Part 2 of 2. With Batman apparently killed and Gordon's hands tied by departmental politics, the Brotherhood of the White Night goes forward with its plan for a truce that will unite every street gang in an all-out war against Gotham City's police force.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Heat, Part 1 of 4. In a Gotham City brought to the boiling point by its worst heat wave in years, the Catman, a thief turned psychotic killer, unleashes an explosion of violence and suspicion, throwing the shadow of blame on both Batman and Catwoman.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Heat, Part 2 of 4. The heat wave continues as Catman escalates from violent thief to full-fledged serial killer, turning Gotham City into a powder keg about to explode into riots. Gordon struggles with a mayor who uses the killings to prey on racial feelings, and Batman is drawn from the hunt to stop mob violence. Plus, Catwoman tackles Catman alone...with disastrous results.

Notes:

  • "DC Universe 10" one page featuring "Larger than Life: the Atom!", "The Man is Back! or is He?" and "DC Bullets."
  • The cover is a homage of the cover of Baffling Mysteries #7.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Heat, Part 3 of 4. Catman's murderous spree continues as the heat wave holds Gotham City at its mercy. Batman and Catwoman form an uneasy alliance to bring down the increasingly unpredictable killer, leading to a three-way confrontation at the Gotham Zoo...until an enraged black panther makes it a foursome!

Notes:

  • Cover dated Early August 1993.
  • "DeeCee 11" one page featuring "Rube's Soapdish", "The Bull's Utter"and "Gripline: Don't Even Wait For It"

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Heat, Part 4 of 4. Batman and Catwoman tangle for the final time with the murderous Catman, forcing the two allies to learn something about one another that will forever shadow their future dealings.

Notes:

  • Cover dated Late August 1993.
  • "DeeCee 11" one page featuring "Rube's Soapdish", "The Bull's Utter"and "Gripline: Don't Even Wait For It"

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
The trail of a professional hitman with the skills of an Olympic pentathlon athlete leads Batman to New Orleans and an encounter with the supernatural soul-stealer known as Ragman, in "Snitch."

Notes:

  • Cover dated Late September 1993.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
Tao, Part 1 of 2. A gang war in Gotham City's Chinatown forces Batman on a collision course with Dragon, a mystically-trained martial arts assassin from China. Dragon's main target is Johnny Kahn, a man Batman is trying to bring to justice. But Dragon has a second target - Batman himself, who was, as a youth, a training rival of Dragon's in the Far East!

Note this, enthusiasts and haters of religions. This issue has Taoism.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Tao, Part 2 of 2. The rivalry between Batman and the martial arts assassin Dragon becomes a duel to the death as Dragon moves to slay his target in Gotham City's Chinatown.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: In "Sanctum," Batman's battle with a deranged killer in an old Gotham City graveyard leads to the shattering of an ancient crypt and the unleashing of an incredible supernatural force that threatens to consume the Dark Knight's sanity, his life...and his very soul!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Watchtower, Part 1 of 3. A potential future for the Dark Knight is depicted as violent crime escalates out of control, and Batman and Commissioner Gordon are challenged by a private security firm's taking steps, both political and covert, to put both men out of business.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Watchtower, Part 2 of 3. In this depiction of a potential future for the Dark Knight, Batman invades Tri-Corner, the area controlled by Vigil, Inc., the ruthless private security agency backed by the mayor. While searching for clues to its insidious private agenda, the Dark Knight discovers he is targeted by an army of Vigil's armored guards, who have him outgunned, outnumbered and out on a limb!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Watchtower, Part 3 of 3. In this depiction of a potential future for Batman, the Dark Knight, beaten and left for dead by agents of the security firm Vigil, Inc., goes to war to stop them from taking over Gotham City. Armed and armored for all-out combat, Batman invades Vigil's Watchtower headquarters to take down its president.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Gotham City is caught in a "Storm" as Batman and Lieutenant Gordon try to protect a visiting political leader from a team of terrorists while contending with an irate CIA agent assigned to the same task, all during a deluge of rain inundating Gotham City.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: KnightQuest: The Search. Quarry, Part 1 of 3. Picking up from elements in Batman Shadow of the Bat (1992) #23, Bruce Wayne continues his relentless pursuit of the abductors of Shondra Kinsolving. Behind the abduction is Benedict Asp, a man with world-threatening plans...and sinister ties to Kinsolving's past!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: KnightQuest: The Search. Quarry, Part 2 of 3. Asp, continuing to turn Shondra Kinsolving's healing skills into a murdering weapon, threatens to kill four more heads of state unless his demands are met. Fearing that Bruce Wayne will also be one of Asp's victims, Alfred attempts to enlist the help of Batman...but the Dark Knight, consumed in his own violent agenda in Gotham City, is reluctant to come to his predecessor's aid.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: KnightQuest: The Search. Quarry, Part 3 of 3. While Batman is decoyed from coming to his predecessor's aid, Bruce Wayne is captured by Benedict Asp on Santa Prisca during a raging hurricane...meaning Wayne is on his own against Asp and his men as he tries to stop an assassination at the hands of Shondra Kinsolving.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
KnightsEnd Part 4. While Batman continues his pursuit of the mysterious arms dealer, Lady Shiva's scheme to corrupt Bruce Wayne into a killer succeeds as, before the very eyes of Nightwing and Robin, Wayne slays the last of the martial arts assassins who have been stalking him!

Notes:

  • Continued from Detective Comics #676.
  • Continued in Robin #8.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
The ultimate climax to the KnightEnd arc.

Jean-Paul Valley is at Wayne Manor for a final confrontation with Bruce. Jean-Paul angrily demands that Bruce take off his costume, saying that he is not the real Batman. Bruce tries to reason with him but Jean-Paul refuses to relinquish the mantle of the bat, citing how he defeated Bane while Bruce spent too much time away from crime solving and that he should just be a billionaire playboy.

Bruce then recalls how Jean-Paul let a criminal die, feeling responsible and protective of his mantle he asks Jean-Paul to give up the costume. Jean-Paul refuses and they battle it out through out the mansion. Bruce realizes that Jean-Paul rigged the entrance to the cave with booby-traps, so he goes out to the mansion to an alternate route to the mansion: the well he fell through as a child. He makes into the back of the cave while Jean-Paul waits unaware that Bruce is already there. Bruce then uses the cave echoes to tell Jean-Paul to take off the costume. The mentally unstable Jean-Paul believes the voice to be his father at first but figures out it's Bruce and charges after him.

Jean-Paul defiantly proclaims that without Batman he is nothing and declares he will not be nothing. They fight in the cave as Bruce leads him away through a narrow part of the cave. Jean-Paul's armor suit is too heavy and too big, so piece be piece he takes it off until he's left with his helmet.

He's ready to fight Bruce but he looks up to see the iconic Batman with light shining down from the well he fell down years ago. Jean-Paul breaks down and tearfully professes that Bruce is Batman and gives up the mantle. Bruce consoles Jean-Paul stating he won't take him to jail. They climb up on to sunny Wayne Manor. Bruce reflects that perhaps this is the time for some light in his life. He forgives Jean-Paul and himself and wishes him luck on his new path.

Bruce walks back to the manor, he's not the Dark Knight today, but today he reclaims his life back.

Notes:

  • "DC Universe 18" one page featuring Chicago Comicon 1994.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman follows a young fugitive into his own personal hell, where reality may be a matter of conjecture, with the Dark Knight as his relentless adversary.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Going Sane, Part 1: Into The Rushing River
description: Going Sane, Part 1 of 4. The Joker victorious! The Dark Knight battles his most dangerous adversary one time too many...and this time the Clown Prince of Crime is the winner! With his oldest foe apparently dead, the Joker is forced to closely examine the relationship between these two mortal enemies and the Joker's dependence upon Batman for his very existence.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Going Sane, Part 2 of 4. Unable to cope with his victory over the Dark Knight, the Joker's mind finally snaps...back to sanity! Now, Having completely blocked out all memory of his criminal past, ordinary Gotham City citizen 'Joe Kerr' begins his life anew, going so far as falling in love. But his longtime insanity may not remain submerged for long, as Kerr becomes locked in a terrifying battle against his own divided mind.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
issue_title: Going Sane, Part 3: Breaking the Surface
description: Going Sane, Part 3 of 4. Recovering from a nearly lethal attack by his archnemesis, Batman resumes his search for the Joker. But the trail leads the Dark Knight unexpectedly to Joseph Kerr, a contented, well-adjusted man who seems too utterly sane to be the maniac Batman seeks.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Going Sane, Part 4 of 4. Batman returns to action in full force, and it triggers the destruction of the Joker's brief return to sanity. The great game against the Dark Knight resumes with manic ferocity as the Joker tries to make certain that this time Batman stays dead.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Criminals, Part 1 of 2. Savage crimes are being committed in Gotham City...seemingly by men already on Death Row, with one suspect executed years ago. Batman goes undercover into Blackgate prison as an inmate and becomes caught between killer prisoners and corrupt guards.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Criminals, Part 2 of 2. Batman finds his undercover prison search suddenly derailed. The warden's life is now in the inmates' bargaining chip, and the only way the Dark Knight can save him is by allowing himself to be unmasked.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Werewolf, Part 1 of 3. The murder of two Wayne Tech employees leads the Dark Knight to London and into the British underworld, bringing Batman face to face with a different kind of killer...a werewolf.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Werewolf, Part 2 of 3. The impossible becomes reality when Batman faces the werewolf. Barely escaping with his life, the Dark Knight pursues the secret behind the killer beast.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Werewolf 3, like a Scooby-Doo story, the werewolf turns out to be a fake; Batman captures the killer.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A disturbed slaughterhouse employee takes twisted inspiration from Batman to become Gotham City's latest serial killer, but soon finds himself being hunted by the Dark Knight himself.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Engines, Part 2 of 2. Seen from the perspective of a serial killer, Batman is united with the murderer against a greater monstrosity born from the heart of Gotham's corruption.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Sleeping, Part 1 of 3. While near death, Batman has an out-of-body experience, trapped in a nightmarish afterlife realm. To return to the living, the Dark Knight must battle savage mythic creatures and find his 'soul twin' - the person who is his fundamental opposite.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Sleeping, Part 2 of 3. While searching for a way out of a strange realm between sleep and death, Batman discovers an unusual river that allows him a brief reunion with his parents, and a glimpse of the life he might have lived without the mantle of the Bat. Will the Dark Knight even want to leave this realm?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Sleeping, Part 3 of 3. Even if they survive the soul-eater, the Dark Knight and his companions can only leave Sleeping through a lake of fire. Will it mean escape...or a fiery death?

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A Legends of the Dark Knight story where something of Bruce Wayne's childhood is stolen. As Batman he hunts for it back.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Gotham gangs purchase clothing and accessories at a Batman store in Gotham, part one of three.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman investigates a serial killer, the Batman stores are instigating crime, part two of three. Batman Master Series trading card bound in the center of the issue.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Batman, with an assist from Jim Gordon, stops both the serial murderer known as the Circuit Killer and the vigilante who has been shooting criminals while wearing a bat mask, part three of three.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Infected" part 1! The Dark Knight faces a horrific new foe with a preference for organic weaponry--specifically, bullets made from bone. But as Batman pursues this mysterious killer, the trail leads to a terrible source: the US government.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The Dark Knight must make a final stand against a pair of bioengineered soldiers-turned-killing-machines--or die trying. But as the battle rages, Batman discovers each monstrosity carries a weapon that could devastate all of Gotham. "Infected" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: In a skyscraper of deathtraps, the Batman finds his skills are put sorely to the test in a battle for survival against the forces of a Gotham crimelord.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Conspiracy" part 1! A rash of occult-ritual murders in Gotham City sends the Batman on a cross-country search to find the source, even as the cult begins fashioning its own line of defense.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Following the clues to a string of occult serial murders, the Dark Knight finds the trail leads all the way to Los Angeles. There he finds a mysterious organization that uses fear and darkness as weapons--in this case, against the Batman! "Conspiracy" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: As "Conspiracy" ends, the Dark Knight--trailing the secret society known as the New Dawn--fights his way through the final level of the conspiracy to avert an assassination...and the fear that even darker forces continue to urge him on.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Clay" part 1! Severely beaten by Clayface, Bruce Wayne finds himself fearing death for the first time. Despite being perhaps the finest human combatant in the world, the Dark Knight finds his skills of little use against a foe with super strength and a body of clay.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Clay" part 2. Desperate for more power, Matthew Hagen bathes in the mysterious clay pool to revitalize his fading abilities and goes mad! Nearly killed in their first battle, the Dark Knight must make a final attempt to stop Clayface or die trying.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Freakout" part 1, written by Garth Ennis! A man walks into a drug house--and openly shoots eight criminals! When Batman arrives on the scene, he comes face to face with the man and his female partner. Meanwhile, across town, Doctor Freak emerges!

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Alarmed over the speed in which LSD 2000, a new and potent form of the illegal drug, has taken over Gotham City, Batman attempts to stop the flow at its source. But Dr. Freak proves to be prepared for the Dark Knight, laying a trap that could shatter the Batman's mind forever! "Freakout" part 2.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Driven insane by Dr. Freak's drugs, Batman goes on a rampage. Only two ex-cop mercenaries stand in the way of his run through Gotham City. "Freakout" finale.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description:
A group of trapped citizens pass the time relating various incidents where they saw or met Batman.

  • Batman in "Die, Bat-Man! Die!!" drawn in the style of Bob Kane.
  • Batman with Robin the Boy Wonder in "The Bulb Boss of Gotham City" drawn in the style of Dick Sprang.
  • Batman in "Age is Unhealthy to Children and other Living Things!" drawn in the style of Neal Adams.
  • "Knightfall Batman" drawn in the style of Vince Giarrano.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Dirty Tricks part 1 of 3: A murderous villain from Bruce's past known as The Magician has appeared in Gotham, and is leaving a fresh trail of corpses in his wake.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The search for the murderer known as The Magician continues in Dirty Tricks Part 2 of 3.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: The hunt for the Magician draws to a close in the conclusion to the Dirty Tricks storyline.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: "Steps" part 1! In the dark and stormy night of Gotham, a killer lies in waiting. He kills his prey with a deadly crossbow and leaves a very particular calling card. Searching furiously throughout the city, the Dark Knight attempts to find the killer, but his only hope lies with an autistic child.

series_title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: A killer is on the loose in Gotham City, and neither the Batman nor the police have any clues to who it is. The answer lies within an autistic child, one who seems to live in his own world. Though the Batman attempts to piece together the puzzle on his own, he fails. Now that his original suspect is also a victim, the Dark Knight has no choice but to seek help from the person he can't seem to get through to.
